review.theoryObservation: All17 complete solution bodies and headings checked against current intro and three facts. Exact= versus rounded≈ distinguished; physical measurements approximate, explicitly exact amounts/counts exact. Every precision request supported and respected. Quizq1 now asks rounded notation, so true> is not competing correct response. Quizq3 explicit2dp removes rounding ambiguity. Calculator sqrt2 finite display no false exact=. All five new example parts derived; E0 deliberate same fraction exact-versus-rounded contrast and E2 explicitbill-versus-measure contrast are mathematically purposeful. No changed numbered steps or incompatible dependent headers; Cat skill has no procedural step list. Complete current published round-decimals content read: intro,sixfacts,three steps,fourexamples,twelve practice solutions, including carry/trailingzeros/reversebounds; requisite next-digit method agrees. No advanced prerequisite method imported.

No images or missing-illustration waiver. Original guided0.954 prompt versus2.954 displayed working is retained as an original source discrepancy, not adopted. Source critical-next-digit and≈ methods support all rounding. Cylinder context supports exact/approximate suitability without introducing volume work. Money-rounding source prevents blanket money-exact rule; candidate exact bill is explicitly stipulated. Recurring calculator source explains finite display rounded, not exact. Fraction exact values and sqrt2 display supplied, no new fraction/surd computation method. Three methods choosing symbol, writing rounded≈, judging suitability all covered.
